name: undergrid
description: UnderGrid: offline-first, crowdsourced survival grid for the Hollow (Patriot HackFest Fall 2026)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm install --prefix desktop --no-audit --no-fund && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build && npm install --prefix desktop --no-audit --no-fund && npm run dist --prefix desktop

author: UnderGrid team
